verdict.rationale: Wave is a SaaS accounting product that holds sensitive financial data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no privacy policy, data-use statement, or opt-out control covering AI model training. The material on receipts OCR, bank feeds and cloud backups is about other features and does not address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
